notes.title: Kay's Destiny 1.4 (Last Major Version)
notes.content:
Major updates!
This version comprehends the full campaign and post game content tested in both languages.
Have fun!

CHANGELOG:
-Jukebox added
-New game + added
-Fixed bugs related to quests, text, positioning, for both languages.
-Fixed some completionism variables.
-Minor/medium bug fixing
-Added bonus contents for 100% completion!

notes.title: Kay's Destiny V1.2.5
notes.content:
Kay's Destiny updates to version 1.2.5

This version includes:
-Full testing of main campaign and all sidequests/minigames of the whole game into both languages (english and italian).
Major/minor gameplay and texts bugfixing

In the last testing phase will be tested all completionism/post game sidequests

notes.title: Kay's Destiny 1.2.4

CHANGELOG 1.2.4

[/list]

notes.title: IMPORTANT MESSAGE
notes.content:
If you played the game at version 1.1 or before, your save game will cause problems further in the game. (you can find the version number in the starting menu screen) 
Please send the Save file in the game folder via email at kaythepianist@gmail.com
To open the game folder, go to Kay's Destiny steam page, click the gear and open the game folder.
You will receive soon new Save file compatible with version 1.1.1. and more
